ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure, a long wooden board ab is placed horizontally on horizontal ground marked with diagonal lines, with the left end of the board labeled a and the right end labeled b. Above the board there is a small wooden block P, and the velocity arrow v above the block points horizontally to the right, indicating that wooden block P slides to the right relative to the long wooden board. Reasoning: Wooden block P slides to the right on the long wooden board, so the direction of the sliding friction force exerted by the long wooden board on wooden block P is to the left; according to action and reaction, the direction of the sliding friction force exerted by wooden block P on the long wooden board is to the right. Wooden block P has no acceleration in the vertical direction, and the normal force between the block and the long wooden board is N=mg, so the magnitude of the sliding friction force exerted by P on the long wooden board is f=μ2N=μ2mg. The problem states that the long wooden board remains stationary all the time, so the resultant force on the long wooden board in the horizontal direction is zero. Therefore, the friction force exerted by the ground on the long wooden board must be to the left, and its magnitude is equal to the magnitude of the friction force exerted by P on the long wooden board, namely μ2mg. μ1 is only related to whether the ground can provide enough friction to keep the board stationary, and does not determine the magnitude of the actual friction force here.

method.method_draft: 先从图像读出：木块P位于长木板ab上，速度箭头v指向右，说明P相对木板向右滑动；木板放在水平地面上。再从题干读出：P质量为m，木板质量为M，木板始终静止，P与木板间动摩擦因数为μ2，木板与地面间给出μ1但木板不相对地面滑动。对木板受力分析：P相对木板向右滑，因此木板受到P施加的滑动摩擦力向右，大小为f=μ2N=μ2mg。由于木板始终静止，水平方向合力为零，所以地面对木板的摩擦力必向左并与该摩擦力等大。因此木板ab受到地面的摩擦力大小为μ2mg。
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：图中一块长木板ab水平放在有斜线标记的水平地面上，木板左端标为a、右端标为b。木板上方有一个小木块P，木块上方的速度箭头v水平指向右，表示木块P相对长木板向右滑动。

推理：木块P在长木板上向右滑动，所以长木板对木块P的滑动摩擦力方向向左；根据作用力与反作用力，木块P对长木板的滑动摩擦力方向向右。木块P竖直方向无加速度，木块与长木板间的正压力N=mg，因此P对长木板的滑动摩擦力大小为f=μ2N=μ2mg。题目说明长木板一直静止，所以长木板水平方向合力为零。于是地面对长木板的摩擦力必须向左，且大小等于P对长木板的摩擦力大小，即μ2mg。μ1只关系到地面能否提供足够摩擦使木板静止，不决定此处实际摩擦力大小。
